channel.title: Farsçadan (English)
channel.description: AI-assisted English translations of selected stories from Iran's Persian-language press. Every story notes the outlet's political orientation.

item.title: BRICS nuclear energy platform convenes in Antalya with Iran delegation
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: BRICS member states' Nuclear Energy Platform held its annual meeting in Antalya; Iran delegation attended. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: U.S. air traffic crashes: 7,000 flights affected, cyber attack ruled out
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: FAA halts all U.S. flights due to communications failure; officials say no signs of malicious attack. (Source: Donya-ye Eqtesad)

item.title: Trump, Xi, and Putin to meet Thursday in Shenzhen—three-way summit
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: U.S., Russian, and Chinese leaders to hold trilateral meeting in China during APEC summit; nuclear weapons and Iran war on agenda. (Source: Donya-ye Eqtesad)

item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Suspicious unmanned aerial vehicle activity confirmed over Lakenheath air base in Britain; U.S. Air Force security deployed. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: UN Security Council debates Iran war—Russia and China call for immediate ceasefire
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: UN Security Council's Middle East session called for ending war with Iran; Iran warned of immediate retaliation to new attacks. (Source: Donya-ye Eqtesad)

item.title: Revolutionary Guards: We struck U.S. early-warning radar in Bahrain in response to Sirik attack
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Revolutionary Guards said they struck a U.S. early-warning radar in Bahrain in response to an attack on Sirik in Hormozgan Province. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Trump reiterated Iran threats despite midterm losses; Congress pushback intensifies
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Trump continued rhetoric on possible military action against Iran despite party's midterm defeat; four Democratic senators oppose war funding. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Pakistan general: Turkey was also at the Tehran four-way talks; dialogue to continue
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Pakistan military spokesman confirmed Turkey's participation in Tehran security talks; all four sides agreed to continue dialogue. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Dollar again approaching 300,000 toman threshold: land-border blockade pressure mounting
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iranian analyst says new restrictions at Pakistan and Iraq borders are pressuring dollar exchange rate; rate may near 300,000 tomans. (Source: Ettela'at)

item.title: Assembly of Experts: NPT withdrawal and defense doctrine review 'inevitable'
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iran's Assembly of Experts said NPT withdrawal has become 'national demand'; warned of unlimited response to any new attack. (Source: Ettela'at)

item.title: G7 Paris statement: Blamed Iran in Hormuz, highlighted Fairford threat
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: G7 foreign ministers called in Paris statement for Iran to guarantee Hormuz ship passage and return to IAEA cooperation. (Source: Iran International)

item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: New York Times reported that U.S. effort to convince Turkey, Iraq, and Pakistan to close land borders with Iran failed. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: UN climate summit COP31 opens in Antalya; Pezeshkian says U.S.-Israel attacks caused greenhouse gas emissions. (Source: Iran International)

item.dc:creator: AI Agent

item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Reuters, Basra Airport officials refused to allow the Iranian national football team's plane to land due to U.S. sanctions. (Source: Iran International)

item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: U.S. charges three people linked to IRGC with involvement in 20 terror attack attempts; one suspect, M.B.S.A., was arrested in Istanbul and brought to New York. (Source: Iran International)

item.dc:creator: AI Agent

item.title: Three competing approaches to ending the war with Iran in Trump administration
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Three rival approaches compete in Washington over how to end war with Iran: continued military pressure, Qatar-mediated diplomacy, and extended naval blockade. (Source: Donya-ye Eqtesad)

item.title: Condemned boxer Vafaei Sani receives Magnitsky human rights award from UK-based organization
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
